reuse.why: Builds one selection predicate/query used by every month-wide action and reuses the tree's extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, getSheetValue, batchMessages and the undoable/mutator registration.

duplication.why: The per-action queries, income checks and sign flips collapse into isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories/averageToBudget; only the extra goal_def/notes join is written in both getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories.

placement.why: The shared definition lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the month-wide actions, their registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: A named rules object makes the averages' stricter null-visibility behaviour explicit and later rules land in one predicate; minor nits are averageToBudget being reused for last month's spending under an average-specific name and the loosely typed goal_def check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three averages all decide through isMonthFillCategory; setNMonthAvg uses averageToBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeated piece is the notes/goal_def join in two SQL queries, which is visible rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory takes a MonthFillRules object (unknownVisibilityIsHidden, the preserved averages inconsistency) and includeHiddenCategories; both are real, named variations and no call site bypasses it.
